description: This Java source file defines the class 'ModifyConnection', which represents a command to modify a 'Connection' within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It provides methods to create instances from objects or JSON, and manages JSON serialization of the connection data.

classes.name: ModifyConnection
classes.description: An immutable command class that encapsulates the logic to modify a Connection object within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It supports creation from objects and JSON, and serialization back to JSON for communication.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new instance of ModifyConnection with a specified Connection and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs a ModifyConnection instance from a JSON string or JSON object, including headers.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Returns the Connection object associated with this command.

methods.name: getConnectionEntityId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the Connection entity affected by this command.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance of ModifyConnection with updated headers.
